svg.title: Resolving two point sources
svg.desc: Two mutually incoherent equal-brightness point sources have circular-aperture Airy intensity profiles. First their separation shrinks; then a larger aperture narrows each profile at fixed separation. Animated motion has a static alternative for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Resolution depends on separation and aperture
First close the sources; then enlarge D at fixed gap. Circular-aperture Airy intensities add
(purple). θR ≈ 1.22λ/D; profiles normalized to one source’s peak.
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
